artworks.title: William Headley
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows a young Black man standing upright, with his feet together and his hands clasped in front of him. He looks out at us with a neutral expression. The top of his head is covered by a hat with an uneven rim, and his clothes are covered in rips and tears. He wears a cloak with a frayed edge over one shoulder, and underneath it is a light shirt or jacket with several holes. His pants are similarly ripped and appear to be made of two different kinds of fabric. His shoes are worn. The wall behind him is light and slightly textured, and the floor has a faint checkered pattern.

artworks.title: Captain Horace James
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man captured from the shoulders upward. He is positioned facing forward directly at the camera. His facial features include a serious expression with a thick and full beard and mustache. He has a prominent forehead and wears round spectacles. His hair is short and combed back, with a slight wave. He is dressed in a dark, buttoned suit or jacket. The background is plain and light-colored, with some faded or aged spots and a thin border around the photograph.

artworks.title: Refugees
artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet (each): 7.8 × 7.6 cm (3 1/16 × 3 in.)
mount: 10.1 × 17.8 cm (4 × 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of around eighteen to twenty individuals in a sepia-toned photograph. They are situated near a wooden structure with a door at the center. Some people are seated on the ground with legs crossed, while others are standing or sitting on a step or a bench. The individuals are looking towards the camera with neutral or solemn expressions. They wear long dresses, shirts, trousers, headscarves, bonnets, and hats. The background features a wooden wall made from horizontal planks and the ground appears to be dirt or possibly straw-covered. No jewelry or objects are visible, and the people are arranged closely together in a group.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, wearing a historical military uniform. He stands facing forward, with his right arm bent and hand resting on a cloth-covered surface. The man has distinct facial features, a mustache, and short hair. He wears a matching hat, with a row of buttons down the front of his uniform and a belt with a rectangular buckle. The backdrop is plain, and the man is framed within an ornate oval frame featuring American flags, stars, and other motifs. The frame is set within a larger square with a textured border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Soldier
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a young male from the waist up. He is seated with both hands resting on his lap. He has a solemn expression with deep-set eyes, full lips, and short, closely-cropped hair. He is wearing a military uniform, including a coat with brass buttons, a belt with a rectangular buckle, and a cap with a short brim. Attached to his belt are two small sheathed knives or tools. The background is plain, and the photograph is housed in an ornate golden frame with an oval opening and decorative floral motifs.

artworks.title: George and William H. Tucker
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This image features two men in a full-body portrait. The man on the left is standing with his right hand resting on the shoulder of the man on the right. Both men are standing straight and facing the camera. The man on the left has short, tightly coiled hair and distinct facial features, wearing a dark suit with a vest, a bow tie, and a long coat. The man on the right has short hair and is wearing a uniform with a hat. He wears a long-sleeve shirt with a scarf tied around his neck and matching trousers. The background is plain and neutral, with a slightly aged appearance.

artworks.title: Portrait of Naval Officers and a Messenger
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in a full-body view. On the left, a young person stands near a railing with an envelope in hand, appearing engaged. Next to them, a man leans casually against the railing, and on the right stands another man in a similar uniform. The background features detailed elements like a landscape painting, a column, a tiled floor, and the architectural design of the banister.

artworks.title: Private Turner Nelson
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright in a full-length portrait. He is facing forward and wearing a military uniform, holding a rifle next to him. There are stacked cannonballs around him, hinting at a military setting. The background includes a blurred historical military scene.

artworks.title: “Rather Die Freemen, than Live to Be Slaves”
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. On the left, there is a person dressed in classical-style garments with draped robes and a laurel wreath around the head, holding a pole or staff. To the right stands a man in a military uniform holding an American flag, with an upright posture and one hand on the flagstaff. The surroundings include an ornate floral border with inscriptions reading "RATHER DIE FREEMEN, THAN LIVE TO BE SLAVES" and "3RD UNITED STATES COLORED TROOPS," along with tents and trees in the background.

artworks.title: Corporal William H. Demby
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation

artworks.title: Refugee Camp, Bullard Plantation
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large group of people gathered outdoors. The scene includes many individuals sitting and standing in an open area in front of several wooden buildings. Some are seated on the ground, while others stand nearby or sit on benches. The attire suggests an earlier period, with long dresses, headscarves, and structured clothing. The background is lined with trees with sparse leaves. The atmosphere seems communal, with people gathered possibly for an event or gathering. The setting appears rural, and the sepia tone of the photograph adds a historical ambiance to the scene.

artworks.title: Aunt Mary Dines
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman seated on a decorative chair. She is facing the camera with a gentle expression on her face. She is wearing a bonnet that covers her hair completely, a high-collared blouse or dress with a large bow at her neck, and long, loose-fitting sleeves. Her hands rest in her lap. The chair has a spiraled design and ornamental details typical of the 19th century. At the bottom of the image, there is text with the name “Aunt Mary” and a personal quote attributed to her.

artworks.title: Reverend Josiah Henson
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust portrait of an elderly man facing forward. He has deep-set eyes, a broad nose, a full, curly white beard, and curly white hair. He is seated upright, dressed in a dark jacket with buttons over a vest and shirt. There are no visible objects in his hands. The background is a plain surface. Below the image, text identifies him as "The Original 'UNCLE TOM.' [Rev. Josiah Henson.]"

artworks.title: Harriet Beecher Stowe and Henry Ward Beecher
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in vintage attire. The man is sitting, holding a hat, with medium-length wavy hair and facial features including a prominent nose and defined eyes. He wears a dark suit with a bow tie. The woman stands beside him, holding a book and fabric, with braided hair and floral accessories. She wears a shawl, blouse, and patterned skirt. The background shows foliage and a rock.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with a Broom
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a woman standing upright, facing slightly to the side with her head turned towards the camera. She has a serious expression and is wearing a headpiece with a ruffled edge that covers her hair. She is dressed in a dark long-sleeved blouse with lace detailing, a high neck, and a fitted waist, paired with a long checkered skirt and an apron. The woman is holding a large broom with both hands. Next to her is a carved chair with patterned fabric. The background shows an ornate patterned wall or backdrop with a floral design, and the floor is covered with a textured rug.

artworks.title: “Natt’s Nurse”
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing next to an ornate table. She is facing slightly right, with one hand resting on the table. The woman has a composed facial expression and short hair with a cap. She is wearing a long-sleeved, striped dress with a high neckline and a white apron tied at her waist. Beside her on the table are a couple of closed books. The background displays a soft, blurred pattern with floral designs and possibly a large, ornate mirror as a decorative element.

artworks.title: Natt Noyes Dodge
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a young child from the waist up, seated with one leg resting on a piece of furniture. The child has short hair, a soft expression, and light-colored eyes. They are wearing a dark outfit with a large bow at the collar, and their left hand rests on the knee. The background is plain, and the photo is mounted on a card with rounded corners.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an older woman standing with one hand on her hip and the other holding a basket. She has short hair under a wide-brimmed hat and a headscarf. She wears layered, worn clothing and knee-high boots. The background has abstract patterns, and there is text in the lower corner: J. S. Mitchell, 77½ West Bay Street, Jacksonville, Fla.

artworks.title: Portrait of Two Men Holding Trays
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows two young men in a full-body pose, standing side by side. Each man is holding a tray in one hand. Both individuals have a direct gaze towards the camera. They have short dark hair and are dressed in matching white jackets with dark trousers. Their jackets are adorned with floral boutonnieres on the left side of their chests. In front of them, there is a table covered with a decorative runner featuring an embroidered bird and floral design. There are several books stacked on the table. The background is an intricately painted backdrop with foliage and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Mrs. Elizabeth Fairfax
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a head and upper-torso portrait of an individual facing forward. The person has short, curly hair and distinct facial features with a neutral expression. They are wearing a dark jacket with large buttons over a striped, high-collared garment. A wide-brimmed hat with a bow or ribbon is on their head. There is a badge or ribbon pinned to their left chest with text on it. The background is plain and neutral, likely from a studio portrait setting, and the photo is an aged, sepia-toned print.

artworks.title: Jefferson Shields
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, sitting upright and facing the camera directly. He has a full, bushy beard and wears spectacles. His hair is thick and neatly combed. He is dressed in a formal suit adorned with medals and ribbons, and a neatly tied bow tie. He holds a cane in his right hand, and a hat with a decorative band is on his lap. The background is a plain, textured surface in sepia tone.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Holding an Accordion
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a standing position. He is facing slightly to the right and holding a musical instrument, possibly a concertina, in both hands. His facial features include a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, round glasses, short gray hair, and a distinguished expression. He is dressed in a double-breasted coat over a high-collared shirt, with a light-colored flower pinned to his left lapel. He is wearing a tall, rounded hat that matches the tone of his coat. The background is plain with some visible texture and a simple rail or banister is visible at the bottom right, suggesting an interior space. The photo shows signs of age.

artworks.title: Portrait of Four Children
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: Four children are depicted in the image, with two standing and two seated. The standing children are positioned on either side of the seated girls. The boy on the left is barefoot and holding one hand to his mouth, looking slightly to his right. The boy on the right is holding a small object in his hand with a calm expression. The seated girls are wearing light-colored dresses with lace details. The girl on the left is smiling broadly with a bonnet, while the girl on the right has curly hair and a serious expression. They are seated on a plush upholstered chair draped with a fur-like fabric. In the background is an ornate backdrop with designs resembling a framed outdoor scene with plants and a decorative border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman Preaching
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is facing slightly to the right with her right hand raised and her left hand holding an open book. Her facial features are visible, and her hair is styled close to her head. She is dressed in a long, dark, full-sleeved gown with a high collar and a crescent-shaped brooch at her waist. The background features an ornately decorated wall with patterns and designs, and the floor is covered with a decorative rug.
